facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet: a large cinematic hero image at the top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle row, and four detail crops along the bottom.
The large top panel is labeled "HERO" and shows a full-body figure standing centered on a wet bridge or walkway at night, with rain falling and city lights and streetlamps glowing behind.
The figure has short dark hair that is shaved at the sides and gathered at the back, visible in the side-profile view.
The figure wears a black high-collared jacket with visible zippers, straps and buckles, a dark shirt, dark cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The middle row contains full-body views labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "BACK" against a dark neutral studio-like background.
The bottom row contains detail crops labeled "FACE", "JACKET COLLAR", "HANDS", and "BOOTS".
In the "FACE" crop, a diagonal scar is visible through the eyebrow on the viewer's left side of the face.
The hero panel uses low-key cinematic lighting with cool blue-gray ambient tones, warm amber highlights from lights, rain streaks, and reflections on wet pavement.
The visible labels on the sheet are "HERO", "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", "BACK", "FACE", "JACKET COLLAR", "HANDS", and "BOOTS".
The bottom detail crops show close views of the jacket collar with a strap and buckle, two hands, and the laced boots.

limitations: Some detail crops and dark areas are low-resolution or heavily shadowed, so fine textures and small markings are not fully legible.
The rainy urban environment appears only in the hero panel; the turnaround and detail panels use a neutral dark background.

card.summary: A cinematic character reference sheet for a dark-clad adult figure, with a rainy nighttime hero image at top, front/side/back turnaround views, and close-up detail panels for the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.
card.characterisation: Adult figure in black utility clothing and combat boots, with a facial scar; presented as a character reference across multiple views.
card.environment: Hero panel: rainy nighttime urban walkway or bridge with wet reflective pavement, metal railings, dark building facades, and streetlights. Turnaround and detail panels: dark neutral studio-like background.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting; cool blue-gray ambient tones in the hero panel with warm amber practical lights, rain streaks, and wet-surface reflections; soft directional light in the studio-style panels.
card.framing: Vertical reference-sheet layout: large full-body hero at top; three full-body turnaround panels in the middle; four close-up detail crops at the bottom.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character concept/reference sheet with an urban noir mood.
